Replace public cached budget/attributes with another genuine budget and require refusal/original object, not renewed admission.

requirements_before_code.requirement: Name an early mounted-root seam that captures the original PaidTaxRequestBudget before body parsing, identity or controller/dependency resolution callbacks. Default-off returns private404 without budget/domain resolution. Retain exact request/budget identity privately once; public request-attribute replacement/recapture must refuse, not renew time. requirements_before_code.basis: PaidTaxProjectionRead has explicit abandon but no destructor; ordinary StreamedResponse cannot by itself abandon a never-started read. Existing transfer has close/destructor, but response construction failures and cycles must not strand it.
meaningful_tests: Actual response never started/destructor-only disposal and encoding/factory/protect/reporter failure release original observer/descriptor/lease; fresh authorized same-owner retry succeeds.
Durable committed attempt remains spent after late refusal/throwing afterCommit; repeated callback/close fails closed or is harmless, no replacement proof.
Reopened/peer frame and dispatcher replacements are preserved by cleanup.
requirements_before_code.requirement: Use a plain original owner/holder before callback-capable domain/result/encoding/factory/protect operations. Successful JSON/attachment response retains it; callback-free proof immediately precedes primitive positive echo. Explicit close/destructor must be idempotent and own only captured read/transfer handles, remain available after policy/deadline refusal, preserve initial errors and unrelated frames/dispatchers, and avoid response/self-capturing cycles. Do not make this ownership optional.

Preserve only validated bounded Allow/Retry-After/rate headers, never arbitrary exception headers/text. Define body-first-byte proof versus already-constructed headers honestly.
